decisions.reason: The coolant pressure booster complements the firm's core coolant management systems, and with industry turnover growing and slack available there is no shortfall prompting search, so management keeps it.
The cleaning centrifuge extends the established filtration offering, and with early results not falling below aspirations the firm can carry it while it matures.
Coolant nozzles are a low-cost add-on that supports system sales and service revenue, so dropping them would release few resources.
Scraper belt chip conveyors are a staple of the firm's core metalworking conveying business and are likely meeting aspiration levels.
The magnetic belt conveyor fills a standard niche in the modular chip conveyor portfolio, and there is no performance problem to trigger reallocation.
Hinged belt conveyors are a high-volume core product close to the established offer and fit the strategy of modular, tailored systems.
